kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs in a sign of a wilting labor market
wire.summary: U.S. employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, and job gains for the two previous months were weaker than initially reported, according to a report Friday from the Labor Department.

wire.title: A new vaccine could vanquish a major cause of deadly diarrheal disease
wire.summary: Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.

wire.title: Trump targets birthright citizenship. And, Iran aims to ban U.S. from Strait of Hormuz
wire.summary: President Trump says he has signed two new orders targeting birthright citizenship. And, Iran is aiming to ban U.S. ships from the Strait of Hormuz.

wire.title: Kalshi and Polymarket bets on clinical trials criticized as 'ghastly'
wire.summary: Researchers warn betting on clinical trials could incentivize insider trading and interfere with drug development. But Kalshi and Polymarket say they provide valuable information to patients.

wire.title: Everyone's talking about hormone therapy for menopause. Should I be on it?
wire.summary: For years, doctors advised against hormone therapy for women in the menopausal transition. Now everyone's talking about how great it is. Is it really a wonder drug that women should all be on?

wire.title: Who or what is 'taking a step back from visibility'? The quiz knows
wire.summary: Plus, if you know what "TMZ" stands for, you'll get at least on question right this week!

wire.title: Amid cost of living stress, many parents are supporting children well into adulthood
wire.summary: Polls show most Americans think young adults today have it harder financially than past generations. A majority of parents help their grown children with expenses, even if it hurts their own finances.

wire.title: Besieged Sudanese city faces relentless drone strikes and risk of mass atrocities, U.N. warns
wire.summary: Hundreds of thousands of civilians in el-Obeid are being battered by relentless drone strikes and face critical water shortages and a worsening cholera outbreak, while women and girls are reporting high rates of sexual violence.

wire.title: When tragedy strikes, America's wildland firefighters ask, was it 'somebody that we loved?'
wire.summary: Deaths and close calls while fighting wildfires have strained an already on-edge workforce. They've also raised questions about policies and priorities amid an intense wildfire season.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Trump issues new orders to limit birthright citizenship, Iran shares details of an agreement with Oman to reopen Strait of Hormuz, Trump under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran.

wire.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
wire.summary: The ruling is in addition to $375m in fines Meta was already ordered to pay in the case, for a total of $942m.

wire.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
wire.summary: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

wire.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
wire.summary: The executive orders ban birth tourism and expand the existing definition of people whose children are not eligible for US birthright citizenship.

wire.title: Australian aviation crew carries out daring midwinter Antarctica rescue
wire.summary: Team evacuated a patient from McMurdo Station after landing plane in total darkness and temperature of -43°C.

wire.title: US strikes $1.2bn deal to pay German firm to halt offshore wind projects
wire.summary: The RWE payout is the latest in a string of deals cancelling wind energy projects, a power source long derided by Trump.

wire.title: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
wire.summary: While precise data is classified, publicly available information suggests the US has used up many difficult-to-manufacture weapons.
